title: Generation of mutant mice with minimal off-target effects by microinjection of one-cell embryos with paired sgRNAs and Cas9 nickase
protocol: Design paired sgRNAs in a tail-to-tail orientation, separated by 10–30 bp.
Select sgRNAs with the sequence 5’-CCN(52–72)GG.
BLAT or BLAST the sgRNA target sites in UCSC or ENSEMBL genome browsers to find those with few or no highly related sites in the genome.
Order sgRNA oligos as described in Figure 2.
Mix 4.5 µl top oligo (100 µM).
Mix 4.5 µl bottom oligo (100 µM).
Add 1 µl NEB buffer to the mixture.
Anneal oligos using a thermocycler with the program: 95°C, 5 min; then from 95–85°C at −2°C/s; then from 85–25°C at −0.1°C/s; hold at 4°C.
Digest 2 µg pUC57-sgRNA with CutSmart Buffer and BsaI.
Incubate the digestion mixture at 37°C for 2 h, shaking occasionally.
Purify the digestion product using MinElute PCR Purification Kit.
Mix 2 µl annealed oligos with 1 µl (25 ng/µl) digested pUC57-sgRNA and 3 µl 2 x Solution I.
Incubate the mixture at 16°C for 30 min.
Transform the ligation product into bacteria and plate on a Kan+ plate (50 µg/ml).
Confirm correct insertion of sgRNA oligos by sequencing using M13-47 primer.
Perform a mini-prep of pUC57-sgRNA plasmid using the QIAprep Spin Miniprep Kit.
Ensure all reagents, tubes, and tips are RNase-free and work in an RNase-free environment.
Digest paired sgRNA plasmids with Dra I.
Add 10 µg of paired sgRNA plasmids (5 µg each).
Add 5 µl of 10 x M buffer.
Add 1 µl of Dra I (15U/µl).
Incubate at 37°C for 3 hours, shaking occasionally.
Check digestion completeness by gel electrophoresis, loading 2 µl on a 1% agarose gel.
Expect two bands at 1621 bp and 1152 bp.
Add 4 µl of RNAsecure to the digested product.
Incubate at 60°C for 10 minutes in a thermomixer.
Purify and elute the digestion product using MinElute PCR Purification Kit with 10 µl RNase-free water.
Recover approximately 5-8 µg of DNA.
For multiplexing experiments, two or more paired sgRNAs can be digested simultaneously in one tube.
Alternatively, prepare the transcription template by PCR amplification from a bacterial colony using sgRNA-For and sgRNA-Rev primers with specified program.
Inactivate RNases by adding RNAsecure.
Purify the PCR product using the MinElute PCR Purification Kit.
Mix 1 μL T7 10X Reaction Buffer, 1 μL T7 ATP Solution, 1 μL T7 CTP Solution, 1 μL T7 GTP Solution, 1 μL T7 UTP Solution, 4 µl purified template, and 1 μL T7 Enzyme Mix to a total volume of 10 µl.
Incubate the reaction at 37°C for 4-6 hours in a water bath or thermocycler with hot lid set to 50°C.
Add 1 μL TURBO DNase and incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes to remove DNA template.
Purify sgRNAs by MEGAclear™ Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Precipitate with 5 M Ammonium Acetate and ethanol.
Resuspend the pellet using 30 μL RNase-free water.
Assess sgRNA yield using the One Drop OD-1000+ Spectrophotometer or equivalent.
Load RNA in DNA loading buffer and run on a 1% agarose gel at 180 V for 10 minutes to assess quality by gel electrophoresis.
Aliquot and store sgRNAs at -80°C.
Digest Cas9-D10A plasmid with Age I.
Purify the digestion product using MinElute PCR Purification Kit.
Transcribe Cas9-D10A in vitro using mMESSAGE mMACHINE® T7 Ultra Kit according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Purify the Cas9-D10A mRNA by RNeasy Mini Kit according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Assess sgRNA yield using One Drop OD-1000+ Spectrophotometer.
Run RNA on a 1% agarose gel (180 V for 10 min) to check quality.
Aliquot and store Cas9-D10A mRNA at -80°C.
Superovulate 4-week-old female C57BL/6J mice by intraperitoneal injection with PMSG at 14:00 of day 1.
Inject superovulated females with HCG at 13:00 of day 3.
Cross superovulated females with males (C57BL/6J or CBA).
Thaw aliquots of Cas9-D10A mRNA and sgRNAs on ice.
Dilute the Cas9-D10A mRNA to a concentration of 20 ng/μl with EmbryoMax® Injection Buffer in a final volume of 50 μl.
Dilute each sgRNA to a concentration of 5 ng/μl in the same final volume of 50 μl.
Pipette the mixture up and down several times.
Centrifuge at 4°C for 1 min at top speed.
Transfer 45 μl of supernatant to a new tube.
Keep the tube on ice.
Inject the RNA mixture into both cytoplasm and larger pronucleus using standard methods.
Collect tail tips from founders (5-day-old).
Digest tail tips overnight at 58°C with lysis buffer containing 100 µg/ml Proteinase K.
Extract genomic DNA by phenol-chloroform method.
Purify the extracted genomic DNA by alcohol precipitation.
Target regions (300–700 bp) are PCR amplified from genomic DNA.
Purify PCR products with the PCR Cleanup Kit.
Denature purified PCR products in NEBuffer 2.
Reanneal denatured PCR products in a thermocycler using the program: 95°C, 5 min; 95–85°C at −2°C/s; 85–25°C at −0.1°C/s; hold at 4°C.
Digest hybridized PCR products with 0.5 µl T7EN1 at 37°C for 30 min.
Separate digested products by 2% agarose gel electrophoresis.
Cloning and sequencing of PCR amplicons from genomic DNA of mutant founders is performed to characterize the mutations.
Perform T-A cloning of PCR products using the T-Vector pMDTM19 kit according to manufacturer’s instructions.
